name: zcode-switchman
description: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync, default model: inherit), model per shell is a user-set frontmatter line, ROUTE_META dispatch discipline, mismatch guard, a failure breaker, and a per-project language preference (first-run ask → [LANG] iron rule). Ships three companion skills: git-commit-message, requirement-docs, db-query (read-only MySQL/Redis).

Ships three companion skills: git-commit-message, requirement-docs, db-query (read-only MySQL/Redis).
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 固定六档子代理编队：会话启动自动装配六壳（正文自动同步、默认 model: inherit），模型由用户一行 frontmatter 自设；ROUTE_META 派发纪律、错配拦截、失败熔断，以及项目级语言偏好（首启三问 → [LANG] 铁律）。随插件附带三个技能：git-commit-message、requirement-docs、db-query（只读 MySQL/Redis 核验）。
